description: Schulwegsicherheit: Fusswege is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Kantonspolizei. Die Daten zur Schulwegsicherheit zeigen auf, wo Strassenübergänge für Kinder im Kindergarten- und Schulalter übersichtlich und einfach sind, bzw. wo erhöhte Anforderungen an das Überqueren der Strasse gestellt werden. Der Datensatz enthält die Achsen der Fusswege, das heisst Trottoirs und wo nötig Strassen. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Public order and security, Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Schulweg, Sicherheit, Kindergarten, Primarschule, Sekundarschule, Schüler. The portal shows 2025-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
